flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4103 then book a free first visit for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown and store the reference as 'ref'.
Get the reference code from the booking confirmation and save as {{ref}}.

remark: click: Clicking Book a free visit
wait: queued plan (4 steps): type "Your name"; type "Email address"; type "Visit date"
click: Clicking the 12pm arrival time radio button
click: Clicking the climbing waiver acceptance checkbox below the booking form group
click: Clicking Confirm my free visit button
wait: PRIMARY: wait 800 ms for the booking confirmation to settle
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'The reference code from the booking confirmation is sav
assert: A booking confirmation with a reference code is shown.

summary:
Booked a free first visit for Sam Rivera using sam@example.com for 2 November 2026 at noon.
Accepted the waiver.
The booking was confirmed and a reference code was shown: PL-4821.
